parsing.notes: 643 MB / ~4.1M rows. Stream line-by-line; do NOT load fully into memory. Strip UTF-8 BOM on the header. The resource download URL changes per dated snapshot; resolve the latest snapshot from the data.gov.ro ONRC organization page.

mapping_rules.company_id: Use CUI (fiscal code); fall back to COD_INMATRICULARE when CUI=0.
mapping_rules.registered_address: Concatenate ADR_* fields; trim leading spaces on ADR_COD_POSTAL.
mapping_rules.vat_id: Compose RO+CUI; confirm VAT registration via anaf_ws_tva.scpTVA.
mapping_rules.status: Not in this file — join onrc_od_stare_firma on COD_INMATRICULARE.

fixture_requirements: active SA/SRL with full address (e.g. CUI 14399840)
entity with CUI=0 (PF without fiscal code)
row with embedded quotes/special chars in DENUMIRE

live_test_plan.smoke: Stream the first ~1000 lines, parse on '^', verify 20 columns and BOM handling.
live_test_plan.full: Process the full 643 MB file behind an env gate; join companion CSVs by COD_INMATRICULARE.
